findings.title: `sanitizeSearchTerm` does not strip PostgREST `.` operator separators
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: apps/api/src/lib/search.ts:26-36 strips `,()."\%*`, collapses whitespace and caps at 100 chars; sanitize-search.test.ts covers a.eq.b / a*b / injection strings. Residual (documented): literal dots are intentionally unsearchable.

findings.title: Admin global search exposes profile PII and never tenant-scopes the organizations query
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: organizations are scoped to the caller's orgs unless a true super admin (apps/api/src/routes/search.ts:191-201) and the PII projection is gated to super admins (search.ts:110-115,120-140); regression tests search.test.ts, search-tenant-scope.test.ts.

findings.title: Raw search terms persisted in plaintext `audit_logs.metadata`
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: search.ts:235-261 audits only a truncated SHA-256 queryHash, queryLength and result counts - never the raw term.

findings.title: Portal search omits documents despite SDK and documentation contract
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: apps/api/src/routes/search-portal.ts:69-88 queries documents with the can_read_document visibility filter; SDK PortalSearchResult includes documents (packages/sdk/src/search.ts:38-42); docs/modules/search-portal.md documents it.

findings.title: Admin search UI silently discards the documents result set
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: AdminGlobalSearch.tsx:19-27,57-65,76 renders the documents group and counts it; PortalGlobalSearch.tsx:158-168 renders portal documents too.

findings.title: No search pagination or result counts; hard 5-result ceiling
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: the admin route accepts ?limit (default 5, cap 25) and returns per-entity exact counts (search.ts:32-33,265-285), surfaced in the SDK (search.ts:20-40) and OpenAPI (spec.ts:1077-1095). Remaining: the portal route still uses a fixed RESULT_LIMIT=5 with no counts/offset (search-portal.ts:18,94-100), documented as fixed-5 in the SDK (search.ts:37) and docs/modules/search-portal.md.

findings.title: Search query analytics metric is dead and the analytics summary RPC is missing
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: recordSearchQuery() is called by both routes (search.ts:263, search-portal.ts:92) and get_analytics_summary is defined service-role-only in supabase/migrations/5302440_search_analytics_summary.sql:20-33.

findings.title: Prefix/wildcard mismatch: no btree on prefix columns and no full-text (`tsvector`) search
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: migration 5302456 adds btree + trigram indexes (organizations.slug/name, profiles.full_name, documents.name/mime_type) and stored generated tsvector columns + GIN for tickets/projects/documents; both routes OR a `search_vector.wfts(english)` branch (search.ts:54-59, search-portal.ts:35-37).

findings.title: Typeahead calls full search endpoints without rate limiting or a dedicated autocomplete surface
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: rateLimitSearch (60/min per user/ip, middleware/rate-limit.ts:69-77) is mounted first on both routes (search.ts:18-20, search-portal.ts:12-14).

findings.title: Admin global search returns private/internal documents without applying the `can_read_document` visibility filter
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: admin search filters documents through filterReadableDocuments with a bounded over-fetch (search.ts:166-185,228-233) and reports the readable subset as the count for non-super-admins (search.ts:275-283); the code mirror matches the SQL helper 5302129 (lib/document-visibility.ts:186-230); tests search-document-visibility.test.ts.

findings.title: Search router bypasses the org-pinned admin check, so a tenant admin can read another tenant's search results
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: the middleware order is requireAuth, requireOrgAccess, requireAdmin (search.ts:22-27) so the org-pinned admin check applies; an explicit organization narrows the search and an absent org never widens it (search.ts:101-108); regression tests search-org-pin.test.ts.

findings.title: Soft-delete columns are defined but never used by queries or deletes
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: the unused deleted_at/deleted_by columns and indexes were dropped (supabase/migrations/5302432_drop_unused_soft_delete_columns.sql) and no runtime code reads them.

findings.title: Search module documentation is stale relative to the code
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: docs/modules/search.md documents scoping, limit/counts, FTS, visibility filtering and the hashed audit; docs/modules/search-portal.md matches the route (fixed-5, documents, rate limit, metric).

findings.title: Search SDK and OpenAPI contracts do not cover the implemented response (documents, counts, limit)
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: packages/sdk/src/search.ts:1-80 models SearchDocument/SearchCounts/limit and PortalSearchResult documents; apps/api/src/openapi/spec.ts:1007-1107 documents both routes' documents/counts shapes.

findings.title: Portal search queries are not audit-logged, unlike the admin search route
findings.note: NEW at 7dd0402: apps/api/src/routes/search-portal.ts has no logAuditEvent call (contrast search.ts:243-261 which records a hashed query + result counts). Portal searches are the highest-volume data-access path and cannot be reconstructed for an incident or DSAR response. Recommend the same privacy-preserving audit event (queryHash/queryLength/resultCounts, never the raw term).
